---
description: Review the current branch against the base branch
argumentHint: "[base-branch]"
---

Review this branch against `$ARGUMENTS` (default `main` when no base is given).

Hold the change to the team's rules in `context/conventions.md`, and work
through `skills/release-audit/release-checklist.md` before approving anything
that touches dependencies.

House style beyond those two is [the style guide](https://example.com/style/guide.md).
